models.label: Qwen 2.5 0.5B Instruct
models.description: Ultra-lightweight 0.5B model. Extremely fast on any GPU or even CPU. Good for quick tests and edge devices.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 1.5B Instruct
models.description: Tiny but surprisingly capable. Great for low-VRAM systems and rapid iteration.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 3B Instruct
models.description: Fast 3B multilingual model. Excellent all-rounder for chat, code, and general tasks.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct
models.description: Balanced 7B model. Strong reasoning, coding, and multilingual support. Best value for most users.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 14B Instruct
models.description: Large 14B model. Excellent quality across all tasks. Needs a mid-range or better GPU.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B
models.description: Specialized coding model. Excellent at code generation, review, and debugging across 40+ languages.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 Coder 14B
models.description: Top-tier open-source coding model. Near GPT-4 level code quality for most tasks.

models.label: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3
models.description: Classic open-weights model from Mistral AI. Strong instruction following and general reasoning.

models.label: Mistral Nemo 12B Instruct
models.description: Mistral's 12B model with a large 128k context window. Great for long documents and complex tasks.

models.label: Phi 3.5 Mini Instruct (3.8B)
models.description: Microsoft's efficient 3.8B model. Punches well above its weight for reasoning and coding tasks.

models.label: Phi 3 Medium Instruct (14B)
models.description: Microsoft's 14B model. Very strong reasoning and STEM performance relative to its size.

models.label: Gemma 2 2B Instruct
models.description: Google's compact Gemma 2. Efficient and capable for its size. Requires HF token acceptance on huggingface.co.

models.label: Gemma 2 9B Instruct
models.description: Google's mid-size Gemma 2. Strong across reasoning, math, and code. Requires HF token acceptance.

models.label: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
models.description: Meta's smallest Llama 3.2. Surprisingly capable for a 1B model. Requires HF token.

models.label: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.description: Meta's compact Llama 3.2. Good general-purpose chat and reasoning. Requires HF token.

models.label: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.description: Meta's 8B Llama 3.1 with 128k context. One of the best open 8B models available. Requires HF token.

models.label: DeepSeek R1 Distill 1.5B
models.description: Tiny reasoning model distilled from DeepSeek R1. Shows chain-of-thought reasoning at a fraction of the cost.

models.label: DeepSeek R1 Distill 7B
models.description: 7B reasoning model distilled from DeepSeek R1. Excellent math and logical reasoning performance.

models.label: DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B
models.description: 8B reasoning model on a Llama backbone. Strong STEM and logical reasoning with chain-of-thought output.

models.label: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct
models.description: HuggingFace's efficient 1.7B model. Designed to run well on-device with surprisingly good quality.
